column3: MT 21:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ (“your victory”) is rendered “Your salvation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you set him as blessings forever” is rendered “You have made him most blessed forever.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at the time of your presence” is rendered “in the time of Your anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make them a shoulder” is rendered “make them turn their back,” and NKJV supplies “Your arrows.”
Close to the Hebrew; רוּמָה (“be exalted, rise”) is rendered “Be exalted.”
